notes.title: MP5 Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, the MP5 Update is live!
The previously-exclusive MP5 is now available to everyone!
Blast enemies away with style!


A Quick Note
As some of you have noticed -- we've attempted to push a build for this update earlier, but have ran into some complications. These have been worked out.

We've also been made aware that issues have cropped up regarding people's Unlockables and previous saved data. These are not intended and we apologize for the inconvenience this has caused some of you. We hope to fix these in future patches.


HOW TO GET THE MP5
The MP5 has now been made available to everyone. In order to be able to see it in-game, you need to meet the following two criteria:

1. You must be in the MP5 Steam Group
Here is a link to the group:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/cofmp5

2. You must have beaten the game at least once
This is so that you can access the Unlockables room, which is where the MP5 has been placed.
There is an unlockables room at the start of the game and after the train sequence (right before the Forest).


Changelog
This update also fixes a few longstanding bugs in the game.
Some notable examples are the Donator TMP disappearing in Co-op, the pages of Simon's book disappearing,  the Flare death crash, and the Doctor boss fight incorrectly recording Accuracy.

We've also optimized the game's code to make things run a lot better! Most areas now have better FPS.

Here's the full changelog:
- Made the MP5 available for everyone
- Updated animations and weapon sounds for the MP5
- Optimized the game code to provide better performance across the board
- Fixed Donator TMP disappearing during level change in Coop
- Fixed Simon's book pages disappearing after completing the game
- Fixed the Doctor boss fight incorrectly counting Accuracy
- Fixed crash when dying while holding Flare/Simon's Book
- Fixed audio bug where music (and sometimes weapon sounds) would not play


Lastly.. here's the video we have created to show off the MP5!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=38xDJXhDiIs

Credits
Kitten of Satanás, Cop_Fighter, and Lightning for the awesome trailer!
MP5 Animations made by Shad
MP5 Sounds made by KAON


Enjoy!
